c01.prompt: Inside the main hall of the old Shen house in the morning: the first frame is filled by an old silver pocket watch and two old wrinkled hands in the cuffs of a grey Chinese-style jacket; the watch's silver chain hangs down from a jacket button. His right hand draws the watch out of the jacket pocket; his left thumb flicks the back cover open with a click; tucked inside the cover is one tiny yellowed torn half of a small photograph, about three centimetres wide. The hands hold still. No mouth in the frame.
